questions.prompt: According to your notes, put the steps of haemostasis in order.
steps: Fibrin forms a mesh that traps blood cells
The clot tightens and the vessel wall is repaired

evidence.quote: First, the damaged vessel narrows, which is called vascular spasm
Finally, the clot tightens and the vessel wall is repaired

questions.explanation: Paragraph 3 gives the order: first, next, then, finally.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, what forms the mesh of threads that traps blood cells in a clot?

evidence.quote: turn fibrinogen into fibrin, which forms a mesh of threads that traps blood cells
platelets stick to the damaged wall and to each other, forming a loose platelet plug
Plasma is the pale yellow liquid part

questions.explanation: Clotting factors turn fibrinogen into fibrin, which forms the mesh; platelets form the earlier loose plug.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, three of these are components of blood. Which one is not?
questions.categoryRule: Blood is made of four main components: plasma, red blood cells, white blood cells and platelets.

evidence.quote: Blood is made of four main components.
Haemoglobin is not a separate component of blood

questions.explanation: Haemoglobin is the protein inside red blood cells, not a separate component.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, connect each blood component to its description.

evidence.quote: Plasma is the pale yellow liquid part
Platelets are small cell fragments that help blood clot.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, about how many days do red blood cells live?

evidence.quote: Red blood cells live for about 120 days.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, give a normal platelet count, in platelets per microlitre of blood. Any value in the normal range counts.

evidence.quote: A normal platelet count is between 150,000 and 450,000 platelets per microlitre of blood.

questions.explanation: Any value from 150,000 to 450,000 is accepted, because your notes give a range.
questions.note: No alternate. Tests thousands separators in quotes.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, the liver needs ______ to make several clotting factors.

evidence.quote: The liver needs vitamin K to make several clotting factors.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, an inherited disorder that stops the blood from clotting normally is called ______.

evidence.quote: Haemophilia is an inherited disorder in which the blood does not clot normally

questions.note: No alternate. Alias covers US spelling.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, about how many days do platelets live? Any value in the stated range counts.

evidence.quote: Platelets live for only about 7 to 10 days

questions.explanation: Any value from 7 to 10 days is accepted.
